chunks: And We wrote for him on the tablets admonition and explanation of all things, so take them with strength and command your people to take the best of them. I will show you the house of the wicked.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the content of the Tablets given to Moses and the instruction to hold them firmly?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as affirming the comprehensiveness of the Torah, which contained both general principles and detailed rulings, serving as a precursor to the final guidance of the Quran. The command to 'take it with strength' underscores the necessity of steadfast adherence to divine law, while the instruction to 'order your people to take the best of it' highlights the principle of selecting the most beneficial rulings for the community's welfare. This reflects the Shia scholarly view that previous scriptures were complete in their time but were later abrogated or preserved in part, pointing towards the ultimate perfection of the Quran.
